explication: Phoniebox is a Raspberry Pi jukebox controlled by RFID cards, GPIO hardware, and a web interface. Its principal workflow maps an RFID card to playback control, with local audio, playlists, podcasts, streams, and Spotify among the documented sources. The web application also manages playback, files, cards, and settings; GPIO devices dispatch configured actions, while an LCD and Bluetooth sink switch support playback and output. Several subsystem links are documented in the README, but their runtime wiring is not shown in the sampled source.
